scope: Finite postprocessing of the already certified first Curve302 M27 chart. No new models, bounds, factorization, target coordinates or point searches.

height_target.rule: same certified range as best single at reference box
height_target.selection: Reuse the retained reference exposure; no target point sets the height limit.

cost_model.meaning: Equal address prices, zero added activation charge in this proxy. These zeros do not measure preparation cost. No complete-cost or CPU estimate is made.

tie_break: objective, active model count, lexicographic height vector
boundary: Optimal only over this certified sufficient-state table and supplied monotone cost model. The selected boxes guarantee coordinate coverage when completely enumerated; they need not contain the old boxes or a new independent point. The displayed costs exclude preparation and are not CPU or recovery probabilities. No change to the sealed three-arm benchmark.
